description: Every Bookclicker workflow, plus a local mirror of the newsletter marketplace that makes launch planning a single query.

tools.name: account_get
tools.description: Get the account snapshot: user settings, owned lists, books and pen names. Returns the AccountSnapshot.

tools.name: booking_calendars_availability
tools.description: Get booking availability for a newsletter and book. Required: list_id. Optional: num_of_months (default: 1), book_id. Returns the new Availability.

params.name: num_of_months
params.description: How many months of availability to return

tools.name: books_create
tools.description: Add a book under a pen name. Required: pen_name_id, title. Optional: launch_date, blurb, amazon_link_url. Returns the new Book.

params.name: pen_name_id
params.description: Pen name that owns this book

tools.name: books_delete
tools.description: Delete a book. Required: id. Returns the DeleteResult. Destructive.

tools.name: books_get
tools.description: Get one book by id. Required: id. Returns the Book.

tools.name: books_list
tools.description: List every book on your account. Returns array of Book.

tools.name: books_update
tools.description: Update a book. Required: id. Optional: title, launch_date, blurb. Returns the updated Book.

tools.name: calendars_availability
tools.description: Get dated availability for a newsletter over N months. Required: list_id, num_of_months (default: 1). Returns the new Availability.

params.name: num_of_months
params.description: How many months of availability to return

tools.name: confirm_promos_create
tools.description: Confirm a promotion was sent, naming the campaign that carried it. Required: reservation_id, reservation_type. Optional: campaign_id, campaign_preview_url, book_owner_email (plus 1 more). Returns the new ConfirmResult.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Newsletter campaign that carried the promotion

params.name: campaign_preview_url
params.description: Public preview URL for the campaign

params.name: book_owner_email
params.description: Email of the book owner being promoted

tools.name: confirm_promos_options
tools.description: List the newsletter campaigns that could satisfy a promotion. Required: id, reservation_type. Returns the ConfirmOptions.

tools.name: conversations_start
tools.description: Start a conversation with another user. Optional: recipient_id, body. Returns the new Conversation.

tools.name: external_reservations_create
tools.description: Record a promotion booked off-platform. Optional: book_id, date, name. Returns the new Reservation.

tools.name: external_reservations_update
tools.description: Update an off-platform promotion record. Required: id. Optional: date, name. Returns the updated Reservation.

tools.name: integrations_get
tools.description: Get one newsletter provider integration and its health status. The provider API key is redacted. Required: id. Returns the Integration.

tools.name: inventories_get
tools.description: Get the promotion slots offered on one date. Required: list_id, date. Returns the OneDayInventory.

tools.name: inventories_set
tools.description: Set the promotion slots offered on one date. Required: list_id, date. Optional: one_day_inventory. Returns the new OneDayInventory.

tools.name: lists_campaigns
tools.description: Campaign history for a newsletter. Required: id. Optional: offset (default: 0). Returns the CampaignList.

tools.name: lists_search
tools.description: Search marketplace newsletters available to promote a book. Optional: preselected_book_id, page (default: 1), per_page (default: 25) (plus 5 more). Returns array of List.

params.name: preselected_book_id
params.description: Scope results to newsletters that accept this book's genre

params.name: per_page
params.description: Newsletters per page. Bookclicker fixes this at 25 and ignores the value; it is declared so sync knows the real page size.

params.name: search
params.description: Free-text search over newsletter and pen name

params.name: inv_type
params.description: Only newsletters offering this promotion type

tools.name: my_lists_list
tools.description: List your own newsletters with pricing and swap settings. Returns array of List.

tools.name: pen_names_create
tools.description: Create a pen name. Required: author_name. Optional: author_profile_url, promo_service_only. Returns the new PenName.

params.name: author_name
params.description: Author name shown to other users

params.name: author_profile_url
params.description: Amazon author URL used for verification

params.name: promo_service_only
params.description: 1 if this is a promo service rather than an author pen name

tools.name: pen_names_delete
tools.description: Delete a pen name. Required: id. Returns the DeleteResult. Destructive.

tools.name: pen_names_for_buyer
tools.description: List pen names eligible to book promotions as a buyer. Returns array of PenName.

tools.name: pen_names_list
tools.description: List your pen names with their books, requests and groups. Returns array of PenName.

tools.name: pen_names_update
tools.description: Update a pen name. Required: id. Optional: author_name, author_profile_url. Returns the updated PenName.

tools.name: reservations_accept
tools.description: Accept an incoming promotion offer. Required: id. Optional: reply_message. Returns the updated Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_buyer_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a promotion you booked. Required: id. Returns the new Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_buyer_cancel_all
tools.description: Cancel every promotion you booked (bulk, destructive). Returns the new BulkResult.

tools.name: reservations_buyer_refund
tools.description: Process a buyer-side refund. Required: id. Returns the new Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_decline
tools.description: Decline an incoming promotion offer. Required: id. Optional: reply_message. Returns the updated Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a reservation notice from the feed. Required: id. Optional: sent_feed. Returns the updated Reservation.

params.name: sent_feed
params.description: Mark the feed item as sent

tools.name: reservations_refund_request
tools.description: Request a refund for a paid promotion. Required: id. Returns the new Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_request_confirmation
tools.description: Ask the seller to confirm a promotion was sent. Required: id. Returns the updated Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_seller_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a promotion booked on your newsletter. Required: id. Returns the new Reservation.

tools.name: reservations_seller_cancel_all
tools.description: Cancel every promotion booked on your newsletters (bulk, destructive). Returns the new BulkResult.

tools.name: reservations_seller_refund
tools.description: Issue a refund as the newsletter owner. Required: id. Returns the new Reservation.
